slides.texte_overlay:
What nobody tells men
about keeping friends
Adult friendships need a plan. Nobody bumps into their friends anymore. A fixed day each month for dinner or football keeps people in your life.
Your friends are fighting battles they don't mention. Men rarely say when they're struggling. Ask "how are you really?" and wait for the answer.
Showing up matters more than the right words. A move, a funeral, a bad breakup. Being there says more than any message you could send.
Old friends deserve a call, not just a like. A two-minute call on their birthday keeps a friendship alive for years. It costs you almost nothing.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Having fresh stories makes every catch-up with friends more fun.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Having fresh stories makes every catch-up with friends more fun.

slides.texte_overlay: Celebrate their wins like they're yours. A new job, a new baby, a marathon. Friends remember who was genuinely happy for them.
Forgive the small stuff. A forgotten birthday or a late reply isn't a betrayal. Long friendships survive because both people let little things go and remember the good times.
